summary: Explicit user rejection of v2 documented. Implemented first actual OBJ/mesh + Mitsuba path tracing pipeline and fail-closed version-matched visual review gate. Front/3-quarter look-dev renders were inspected and rejected in-house: hair, neck, tailoring, likeness and cinematic realism are below target. v3 master not produced; v2 preserved historically. 14/14 tests PASS, repository validation 21 PASS/1 warning.
next_action: Wait for an approved textured rig/3D scan OR a neutral unfiltered front/three-quarter/profile/back face-and-body 360 capture, plus clarification whether photograph-based PBR textures on actual 3D meshes are allowed. If proceeding from existing assets, keep this as look development and rebuild model until the user accepts a short rigid-head/hand/wardrobe proof; only then render the reference-timed full film with clean crown/title, audio, QA and sync. Never reissue image-plate v2 as v3.
